Integers only: kg, kg per m2, mm, cells, ticks at 20 per second, permille. Segment strength = deck area m2 * strengthKgPerM2 * current strength permille / 1000 (ice: thickness mm * iceKgPerM2PerMm). Load = masses of units whose centre is on the segment (soldiers, engines, boats, animals), not launched or swept ones. Checked every field step; a segment fails when load >= strength at failChecks consecutive checks. Strain stages from plan M5 (creak 70%, crack 85%, sag 95%; for the player only, regiments never read them, brief 2026-10-09); a stage falls back stageHysteresisPermille below its threshold. A failed bridge segment's neighbours lose neighbourLossPermille of maximum; a broken ice patch's lose iceNeighbourLossPermille. Pontoons: strength scales from groundedPermille below groundedDepthMm of water under the deck to full at afloatDepthMm. coldDrowningTicks: drowning timer for soldiers in a broken-ice hole (until S3). Numbers are proposals.
